coverage: First-round reference profile; identification and biographical details await review.

attestations.text: FU-ch'üan 福全, Sept. 6, 1653–1703, Aug. 8, was the second son of Emperor Shih-tsu (Fu-lin, q.v.). His mother, daughter of the chieftain of the Donggo clan, was an imperial concubine of the third rank (庶妃 shu-fei) when her son was born.
